dialogues.jp: 「ただいま……ってあれ？」
dialogues.en: "I'm home...... huh?"
dialogues.text: "I'm home...... huh?"

dialogues.jp:
月曜日のこの時間は、天変地異が起ころうとも
テレビにかじりついている音夢がいない。
dialogues.en:
I didn't see Nemu in front of the TV. Usually at this time
on Monday afternoons, she's watching TV like she's about to
eat it, every week, no matter what happens.
dialogues.text:
I didn't see Nemu in front of the TV. Usually at this time
on Monday afternoons, she's watching TV like she's about to
eat it, every week, no matter what happens.

dialogues.jp: 「かじりつくといえばさくらだが」
dialogues.en: "Talk about biting, is Sakura for sure."
dialogues.text: "Talk about biting, is Sakura for sure."

dialogues.jp:
自分でもわけの分からないことを言って、慣れ
た挨拶がなくて調子を崩したまま部屋に戻る。
dialogues.en:
I didn't make sense, but it felt weird not having Nemu greet
me when I come home. I just went back to my room.
dialogues.text:
I didn't make sense, but it felt weird not having Nemu greet
me when I come home. I just went back to my room.

dialogues.jp:
「はぁ〜、テストも終わったし後は春休みを待
　つだけだ」
dialogues.en: "Phew! The exams are over, and spring break here I come!"
dialogues.text: "Phew! The exams are over, and spring break here I come!"

dialogues.jp: ベッドに寝転がり、天井に手をつきだして叫ぶ。
dialogues.en: I rolled on the bed and raised my hands in the air.
dialogues.text: I rolled on the bed and raised my hands in the air.

dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、だるいだるい」
dialogues.en: "Mm, I'm so tired."
dialogues.text: "Mm, I'm so tired."

dialogues.jp:
目を閉じて大の字になると、窓の外から、穏や
かな鳥の声と車の音が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en:
I heard sounds of birds chirping and cars going by outside
my window as I lay flat on my bed.
dialogues.text:
I heard sounds of birds chirping and cars going by outside
my window as I lay flat on my bed.

dialogues.jp:
そして、すぐに身体が沈むような眠気が襲って
きた。
dialogues.en: And then, I felt drowsiness overcoming me gradually.
dialogues.text: And then, I felt drowsiness overcoming me gradually.

dialogues.jp: はい。無条件降伏させて頂きます。
dialogues.en: Yep. I'm not fighting it.
dialogues.text: Yep. I'm not fighting it.

dialogues.jp: ――プル
dialogues.en: ---- Ring.
dialogues.text: ---- Ring.

dialogues.jp: ――プルルル
dialogues.en: -----Ring, Ring.
dialogues.text: -----Ring, Ring.

dialogues.jp: むくりと起き上がって部屋を出る。
dialogues.en: I raised my body up and stepped outside of my room.
dialogues.text: I raised my body up and stepped outside of my room.

dialogues.jp: 「俺の眠りを邪魔するのは誰だ？」
dialogues.en: The living room.
dialogues.text: The living room.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『兄さん……知り合い以外からの電話だったら、
　どうするつもりですか？』
dialogues.en: The phone.
dialogues.text: The phone.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はっはっは。なんだ音夢か。携帯にかけろよ」
dialogues.en: "Who's disturbing my sleep?"
dialogues.text: "Who's disturbing my sleep?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『いえ、家にいないのなら間に合わないから』
dialogues.en:
"What would you have done if this was a phone call from
someone you don't know?"
dialogues.text:
"What would you have done if this was a phone call from
someone you don't know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「間に合わない？　時限爆弾の解除か？」
dialogues.en:
"No, you won't make it in time if you aren't at home
anyway."
dialogues.text:
"No, you won't make it in time if you aren't at home
anyway."

dialogues.jp: 眠い目をこすって時計を見る。
dialogues.en:
"What won't make it? Are you talking about disarming a time
bomb?"
dialogues.text:
"What won't make it? Are you talking about disarming a time
bomb?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『お願い兄さん！　急にバイトが入っちゃった
　の。すぐにあのドラマを録画して！』
dialogues.en: I looked at the clock rubbing my eye.
dialogues.text: I looked at the clock rubbing my eye.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、あ……あれね」
dialogues.en:
"I have to work unexpectedly, could you tape that show for
me, please?"
dialogues.text:
"I have to work unexpectedly, could you tape that show for
me, please?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢がはまっている、再放送の学園恋愛物を思
い出す。
dialogues.en: "Huh, oh...... that show."
dialogues.text: "Huh, oh...... that show."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『もう始まっちゃってるの〜、見たいの〜』
dialogues.en:
I remembered the rerun of the school love comedy show Nemu
loves.
dialogues.text:
I remembered the rerun of the school love comedy show Nemu
loves.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「その変な口調をやめたら録ってやる」
dialogues.en:
"It's already started, and I really want to watch it,
pleeeeeease?"
dialogues.text:
"It's already started, and I really want to watch it,
pleeeeeease?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『本当？　うわっ、感謝感激♪』
dialogues.en: "I'll do it if you stop talking like that."
dialogues.text: "I'll do it if you stop talking like that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「切っていいか？」
dialogues.en: "Really? Wow, I'm so happy, happy!!"
dialogues.text: "Really? Wow, I'm so happy, happy!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『あ、ごめんごめん、お願いします。ビデオは
　そのまま入ってるのを使っていいから』
dialogues.en: "Can I hang up?"
dialogues.text: "Can I hang up?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「分かったよ。やっておくから心置きなくバイ
　トに励め」
dialogues.en:
"Oops, sorry. Please. You can use the tape in the VCR just
like that."
dialogues.text:
"Oops, sorry. Please. You can use the tape in the VCR just
like that."

dialogues.jp:
手元にリモコンをひきよせて、ピピッ、と録画
を開始する。
dialogues.en: "I got it. Don't worry about it and go back to your work."
dialogues.text: "I got it. Don't worry about it and go back to your work."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『励めってねぇ……万年遊び人の兄さんがそう
　いうこと言うかなぁ』
dialogues.en:
I reached for the remote control and pushed the recording
button.
dialogues.text:
I reached for the remote control and pushed the recording
button.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あのな、お前はそのバイト代を何に使ってる
　んだ？」
dialogues.en:
"Back to your work...... how could you say such a thing when
you don't even work?"
dialogues.text:
"Back to your work...... how could you say such a thing when
you don't even work?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 『あ、えへへへ……お洋服とお買い物です』
dialogues.en: "Hey, what are you using the money from work for?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, what are you using the money from work for?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「しっかり稼げ」
dialogues.en: "Well, clothes and other shopping......"
dialogues.text: "Well, clothes and other shopping......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
『は〜い♪　ありがとね兄さん。今度なんでも
　言うこと聞くから。それじゃ』
dialogues.en: "Fine. Thanks. I'll do you a favor next time. Bye."
dialogues.text: "Fine. Thanks. I'll do you a favor next time. Bye."

dialogues.jp: 電話が切れた。
dialogues.en: She hangs up.
dialogues.text: She hangs up.

dialogues.jp: 眠気は吹っ飛んでいた。
dialogues.en: My drowsiness was gone.
dialogues.text: My drowsiness was gone.

dialogues.jp: 「なんでも……なんでもか……」
dialogues.en: "She'll do me a favor......"
dialogues.text: "She'll do me a favor......"

dialogues.jp:
受話器を戻しながら、色々なことを検討してみ
る。
dialogues.en: I put the phone back and thought about the possibilities.
dialogues.text: I put the phone back and thought about the possibilities.

dialogues.jp:
テスト期間というものは｛もんもん／悶々｝とたまるのか、本
当に想像力がたくましくなっている。
dialogues.en:
My imagination took wings now that the exam week was over,
and made me horny.
dialogues.text:
My imagination took wings now that the exam week was over,
and made me horny.

dialogues.jp: 色々……色々かぁ。

dialogues.en: What would it be...
dialogues.text: What would it be...

dialogues.jp:
ため息をついて窓辺に歩み寄り、近所迷惑覚悟
で大きく息を吸い込んだ。
dialogues.en:
I walked to the window with a sigh and took a deep breath,
thinking I'd be bothering the neighbors.
dialogues.text:
I walked to the window with a sigh and took a deep breath,
thinking I'd be bothering the neighbors.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなこと、したいけど出来るか〜〜〜〜！」
dialogues.en: "How could I do all that!!!"
dialogues.text: "How could I do all that!!!"

dialogues.jp: ◆お願い兄さん◆
dialogues.en: ◆Please, niisan◆
dialogues.text: ◆Please, niisan◆

dialogues.jp:
急にバイトが入り、ドラマを見れなくなってし
まった音夢。
dialogues.en:
Nemu had to work unexpectedly, and she wasn't able to watch
her favorite show.
dialogues.text:
Nemu had to work unexpectedly, and she wasn't able to watch
her favorite show.

dialogues.jp:
電話で俺に録画を頼んだあと、今度なんでも言
うことをきいてあげると言って、電話を切った。
dialogues.en:
She called me to tape the show for her, and she said she'll
do me a favor in return, then she hangs up the phone.
dialogues.text:
She called me to tape the show for her, and she said she'll
do me a favor in return, then she hangs up the phone.

dialogues.jp:
そんな音夢の言葉に、俺は妄想を｛たくま／逞｝しくするの
だった。
dialogues.en:
My imagination flew out the window as she promised to do me
a favor.
dialogues.text:
My imagination flew out the window as she promised to do me
a favor.
